workflow_name: Expenses document date for later period v/s posting date in previous period / qtr
workflow_description: Flag line items where Document Date falls in a later accounting month-year than Posting Date, including across years, indicating potential timing irregularities.
business_logic_plan:
Business Logic Plan: Expenses document date later than posting date (period/quarter)

1) Data source
- Input CSV: FBL3N.csv
- Relevant columns used:
  - Document Date
  - Posting Date
  - Company Code
  - Document Number
  - G/L Account
  - G/L Acct Long Text.1
  - Amount in local currency
  - Local Currency
  - Document currency
  - Document Type
  - Posting Key
  - Cost Center
  - Profit Center
  - Text
  - Document Header Text
  - Reference
  - Entry Date
  - User Name
  - Year/month
  - Offsett.account type
  - Offsetting acct no.

2) Population
- Include all rows (no pre-filtering)
- Include all postings regardless of debit/credit
- No exclusions

3) Core exception rule
- Flag a record if month-year(Document Date) is later than month-year(Posting Date), including across years
- No grace window
- No materiality threshold on Amount in local currency

4) Derived fields and calculations
- Document Year: extract year from Document Date
- Document Month: extract month number from Document Date
- Posting Year: extract year from Posting Date
- Posting Month: extract month number from Posting Date
- Document Month-Year: concatenate [Document Year]-[Document Month] in YYYY-MM form
- Posting Month-Year: concatenate [Posting Year]-[Posting Month] in YYYY-MM form
- Months Difference:
  - months_diff = (Document Year - Posting Year) * 12 + (Document Month - Posting Month)
- Doc Quarter:
  - doc_qtr = ceil(Document Month / 3) resulting in 1..4
- Post Quarter:
  - post_qtr = ceil(Posting Month / 3) resulting in 1..4
- Quarter Difference:
  - qtr_diff = (Document Year - Posting Year) * 4 + (doc_qtr - post_qtr)
- Cross-Year Flag:
  - cross_year_flag = "Y" if Document Year > Posting Year else "N"
- Exception Flag:
  - exception_flag = months_diff > 0
- Exception Reason:
  - exception_reason = "Document period later than posting period"

5) Filtering logic
- Keep only rows where exception_flag is true (months_diff > 0)

6) Output CSV schema (single file)
- Identification columns:
  - Company Code
  - Document Number
  - G/L Account
  - G/L Acct Long Text.1
- Business logic columns:
  - Document Date
  - Posting Date
- Context columns:
  - Amount in local currency
  - Local Currency
  - Document currency
  - Document Type
  - Posting Key
  - Cost Center
  - Profit Center
  - Text
  - Document Header Text
  - Reference
  - Entry Date
  - User Name
  - Year/month
  - Offsett.account type
  - Offsetting acct no.
- Calculated columns:
  - Document Month-Year
  - Posting Month-Year
  - Months Difference
  - Doc Quarter
  - Post Quarter
  - Quarter Difference
  - Cross-Year Flag
  - Exception Reason

7) Row meaning
- Each row in the output represents a single flagged line item where the Document Date falls in a later accounting month-year than the Posting Date

8) Suggested ordering in output
- Sort primarily by Months Difference descending
- Then by Document Date ascending
- Then by absolute Amount in local currency descending (optional)

9) Implementation steps
- Step 1: Load FBL3N.csv
- Step 2: Create derived fields listed in section 4 using Document Date and Posting Date
- Step 3: Compute exception_flag using months_diff > 0
- Step 4: Filter to rows where exception_flag is true
- Step 5: Select columns per the Output CSV schema
- Step 6: Sort as suggested
- Step 7: Export as a single CSV file of flagged exceptions

10) Example pseudocode (logic outline)
- Load data as df
- Derive:
  - doc_year = year(Document Date)
  - doc_month = month(Document Date)
  - post_year = year(Posting Date)
  - post_month = month(Posting Date)
  - Document Month-Year = f"{doc_year}-{doc_month:02d}"
  - Posting Month-Year = f"{post_year}-{post_month:02d}"
  - Months Difference = (doc_year - post_year) * 12 + (doc_month - post_month)
  - Doc Quarter = ((doc_month - 1) // 3) + 1
  - Post Quarter = ((post_month - 1) // 3) + 1
  - Quarter Difference = (doc_year - post_year) * 4 + (Doc Quarter - Post Quarter)
  - Cross-Year Flag = "Y" if doc_year > post_year else "N"
  - Exception Reason = "Document period later than posting period"
- Filter: df = df[Months Difference > 0]
- Select and order columns as defined
- Sort as suggested
- Write CSV

11) Acceptance criteria
- Only records where Document Month-Year is strictly later than Posting Month-Year are included
- No amount threshold or grace window applied
- All postings and categories included; no exclusions
- Output contains all specified context and calculated columns to facilitate investigation
